text: Implemented: NAMESPACES, split_signatures, signer_of(rel,data,sig,keys)->PersonKey (namespace from path; exactly one block), verify_person (exactly one valid sig per non-retired key; extras/repeats rejected; zero current keys rejected), verify_approval(rel,tier|endorsement,data,sig,signer_person)->PersonKey (named did:key must be one of signer's keys). Revocation signer policy (self/other own key/anchor) left to ey47.5: call signer_of with candidate keys. Multi-sig .sig format = concatenated ssh-keygen armored blocks. Open Qs: person file with all keys retired; snapshot check cannot prove rotation chain (new key signed by an old one) without git history.
